description.en:
Runs a whole short talk with an NPC as a stand scene. First the field models face each other: with both _main_rot and _npc_rot 0 or more, each turns with CMND_CHR_TURN_AUTO_TRG (the values are the motion numbers) and the function waits. Otherwise it calls CMND_TALK_START on the NPC and QuickTurn (the NPC turns only if CMND_TALK_START says so).
Then it opens the stand scene (StartStandEvent), places the two detailed models with SetHiMdlPosAndMotID, fades them in, shows the message _talk_id, fades them out and closes the scene (EndStandEvent). Nothing is turned when _npc_hdlL is 0 or less.
EV_CHARA_POS_LEFT or EV_CHARA_POS_RIGHT for the player character.
Base ID of the player character, e.g. "cp0008".
NPC's field model (0 or less to skip the turning).
Motion number for the player character's turn; -1 to use QuickTurn.
Motion number for the NPC's turn.

examples.case: A talk with an NPC (real usage, from ev42011300.nut; the Shift-JIS object names are replaced by variables here)
